discription: Two slightly detuned sine waves create a rich, chorused pad-like sound with an controllable ADSR envelope.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, detune=1.005, attack=0.01, decay=0.1, sustain=0.8, release=1.0; var sig; var env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(attack, decay, sustain, release, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2); sig = (SinOsc.ar(freq) + SinOsc.ar(freq * detune)) * 0.5; sig = sig * amp * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
